title: Derivative via singleton Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $p\\in(0,1$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$. The biased expectation polynomial $P_f$ is differentiable at $1-2p$, with derivative $\\sigma(p)^{-1}\\sum_{i=1}^n\\widehat f_p(\\{i\\})$, where $\\sigma(p)=\\sqrt{4p(1-p)}$ and $\\widehat f_p$ denotes the Fourier coefficient for the biased product measure with parameter $p$.
